verdict.rationale: Apify documents its own MCP server that lets AI agents and LLMs discover and use Actors, so users can drive the platform in natural language through an MCP-capable agent. The evidence shows no natural-language interface built into Apify itself; the language understanding comes from an external agent client. Missing for 10: a native natural-language command interface in the Apify console or CLI, documentation of which platform operations are available via natural language through MCP, and hands-on or independent corroboration of natural-language operation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Discover and use Actors with AI agents and LLMs via Apify MCP server.
